verdict.rationale: Pylon's Support Agent is said to deflect questions "using content," and admins can steer it with natural-language runbooks, persona tuning, simulation testing and QA rubrics. None of the evidence documents a guardrail that stops invented policies, prices or promises, or that makes off-knowledge questions get a safe decline. These are adjacent controls (instructions, post-hoc rubric checks, issue assignment), not the guardrail capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, guardrails stop the agent from inventing policies, prices, or promises — off-knowledge questions get a safe decline, not a guess
